name: @ensemble/control-plane
description: Reference control plane for the Part 3 contract (plan Part 5): authenticated session brokering (Part 6 trust boundary — server-side code exchange, session issuance/refresh/revocation), durable storage behind one interface (sessions, identities, tasks, bindings, gates, execution attempts, leases, job checkpoints, key custody), envelope-encrypted key custody with a KMS-held KEK, per-user ownership enforcement, WebSocket subscription auth + fan-out, sandbox lifecycle composition, and engine job supervision with restart recovery.
